title: Grusch on Sarbacher's role in standing up the program

tellings.quote: Sarbacher, is somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered, right?

plain: A physicist named Robert Sarbacher is said to have helped set up the secret government effort that handles recovered craft, sometime between the 1940s and the 1950s. The man who says so is David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who became a whistleblower about that effort, and he says it only in passing: Sarbacher is "somebody purportedly involved in the stand-up of the stuff that I uncovered." If true, it would place the effort's beginnings in the years right after the Second World War.
